1. **Pick it up** (add it to inventory)

He looks at you now, and there's no defiance left, only a hollow kind of pleading.

"It's not just me. Half the town wakes up wrong. Mara's lost whole nights. Even old Thom over there." A jerk of his chin toward the hearth. "So either I'm going mad with everyone else, or something *is* taking the hours. And I don't know which one scares me more."

The tavern creaks around you. A drinker coughs. The barkeep sets down a glass with a soft clink.

The lanterns flicker. Around you, the crowd begins to thin, people drifting back to their homes with the same hollow exhaustion they arrived with. The cobbles are still stained. The hours are still missing. You've bought time and fragile cooperation, but the thing underneath—the real wound—remains untouched.

Elric meets your eyes. "We'll begin the inquiry at first light. The wizard's records. The timeline. All of it." He pauses. "You'll want to be present."

It is not a question.
